mapper.insert: INSERT INTO judgment (id, answer_id, process_status, rubric_version_id, retry_count, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{answerId}, 'PENDING', #{rubricVersionId}, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: WITH latest AS ( SELECT id FROM followup WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT latest.id FROM latest WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer WHERE answer.followup_id = latest.id)

SELECT a.id AS answer_id, a.version, a.submitted_at, a.input_type, a.plain_text, a.followup_id, f.question AS followup_question, a.content, j.process_status FROM answer a JOIN judgment j ON j.answer_id = a.id LEFT JOIN followup f ON f.id = a.followup_id WHERE a.attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY a.version
SELECT id AS answer_id, attempt_id, version, input_type, content, COALESCE(plain_text, '') AS plain_text FROM answer WHERE id = #{answerId}
SELECT id, answer_id, process_status, lease_until, retry_count FROM judgment WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}
SELECT t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND t.finished_at IS NULL FROM attempt t JOIN answer a ON a.attempt_id = t.id WHERE a.id = #{answerId} FOR UPDATE OF t
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO judgment_element (id, judgment_id, rubric_element_id, quote, verified, satisfied, source_type) VALUES
(gen_random_uuid(), #{judgmentId}, #{e.rubricElementId}, #{e.quote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.verified}, #{e.satisfied}, #{e.sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id AS answer_id, a.attempt_id, (t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND t.finished_at IS NULL) AS attempt_open, j.process_status, j.result, j.trial, j.held_reason, j.model_version, j.prompt_version, m.code || '@' || v.version AS mission_label, m.code || '@' || rv.version AS rubric_label FROM answer a JOIN judgment j ON j.answer_id = a.id JOIN attempt t ON t.id = a.attempt_id JOIN mission m ON m.id = t.mission_id JOIN mission_version v ON v.id = t.mission_version_id JOIN rubric_version rv ON rv.id = j.rubric_version_id
ORDER BY a.version

SELECT a.id AS answer_id, e.rubric_element_id AS element_id, r.label, e.satisfied, e.quote, e.source_type FROM answer a JOIN judgment j ON j.answer_id = a.id AND j.process_status = 'DONE' JOIN judgment_element e ON e.judgment_id = j.id JOIN rubric_element r ON r.id = e.rubric_element_id
ORDER BY a.version, r.sort_order
